question: Does the chat engine work when actually invoked (authenticated, real question, chart 482012f1)?
root_cause: The deployed /api/chat/consult engine authenticates and plans correctly but FAILS DETERMINISTICALLY with HTTP 500 at bundle hydration on EVERY request, before any synthesis or streaming. Cause: platform/src/lib/bundle/bundle_hydrator.ts line 25 hard-codes FLOOR_ASSET_IDS = ['FORENSIC','CGM'] and line 96 throws `bundle_hydrator: floor asset '<id>' not found in manifest` when a mandatory floor asset is absent from CAPABILITY_MANIFEST.json. The FORENSIC asset was DELETED from the manifest in PR #187 Legacy Teardown (per CLAUDE.md §B: 'FORENSIC v8.0 markdown was deleted in PR #187'), so `grep -c FORENSIC 00_ARCHITECTURE/CAPABILITY_MANIFEST.json` = 0. route.ts calls hydrateBundle(plan,manifest) at line 689 inside the main try block; the throw is caught by the outer catch at line 1023-1027 which returns res.internal(msg) → HTTP 500 {code:SYSTEM_INTERNAL, retry:false}. This is the SAME failure CLASS as the LCA-2 retired-`reports`-table regression (a retired-legacy relic still referenced in the live consult path); LCA-2 was fixed in route.ts (reports lookup removed, lines 306-316) but that fix unblocked the request far enough to now hit the NEXT retired-relic relic one stage downstream in bundle_hydrator. It is a NEW, distinct regression from LCA-2 — same class, different file/asset. This is NOT a cold-start effect: two invocations 3.5 min apart produced byte-identical 500s.

residual_unknown: Whether removing/repairing the FORENSIC floor-asset requirement in bundle_hydrator.ts yields a further downstream failure (a THIRD retired-relic relic) or a clean success — cannot be known without the code change (out of this read-only lane's scope). The engine has NEVER produced a completed reading against this DB (conversation_messages=0 all-time), so full end-to-end synthesis remains unproven even after this fix.
recommended_action: HIGH-PRIORITY one-line fix candidate: in platform/src/lib/bundle/bundle_hydrator.ts line 25, remove 'FORENSIC' from FLOOR_ASSET_IDS (FORENSIC was retired in PR #187; the panchanga/retrieval path already supersedes it per CLAUDE.md §B) — leaving CGM as the sole floor asset (verify CGM resolves in CAPABILITY_MANIFEST.json first). This is the direct analogue of the LCA-2 fix (remove the retired-relic reference, do NOT resurrect the asset). After the fix, re-run this exact X-2 probe to confirm the engine produces an SSE stream + persists conversation_messages + fires the mcp_predictions detector. Also: add a manifest-vs-FLOOR_ASSET_IDS CI assertion so a retired floor asset fails the build, not production request #1. Separately: the eager-conversation-insert (route.ts:375) creates orphaned rows on every pre-stream failure — consider moving it inside the try or cleaning up on catch.
